data.summary: Extended E185 Stage A knitting repair planner with 4 new fixtures (F9-F12) testing lacy_decrease, wrong stitch type on rib, wrong cable crossing, and extra yarnover on 8x8 fabrics. All new error types successfully repaired by local planner (A1). Aggregate improvement rate: 6/7 = 0.857 >= 0.625 kill threshold, so kill gate NOT FIRED. Computational extension confirms approach generalizes across fabric types and shows even better improvement (100% on F1) than original Stage A aggregate (6/8 = 0.75). Kill gate not fired means candidate direction stays open. Physical Stage B falsification would require materials/knitter not available in this environment.
